description: Read the signed-in account’s UTC free-send allowance, prepaid balance in cents, reserved cents and last 20 charges. Use it before sending tasks that may cost credit; prices are in get_m2m_network, and a payment_required reply carries the top-up link. Uses the same ledger as REST and your developer page. Requires direct:tasks. Changes nothing; phone minutes and legacy credits are separate.
name: get_direct_usage
title: Your Direct allowance and credits
